caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned slightly diagonally against a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a hand press, resembling a waffle iron or similar implement. It consists of a rectangular, grid-patterned lower section, resembling a mold or press, colored in various shades of brown. Attached to this section are two elongated, cylindrical handles, each ending in a round knob. These handles extend upward at angles from the central hinge where they join the mold. There is visible shading around the edges and surfaces, which gives the object a three-dimensional appearance, with the brown tones blending from light to dark to show depth and form. The composition centers the object within the page with ample negative space surrounding it. The artist's name, "Manuel Enríquez," is faintly inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Fireplace Waffle Iron
